en.title: Maximum Adjacent Gap
en.description:
Find the maximum absolute difference between adjacent elements in input order. The source's examples and constraints are explicit; this site adds the standard input protocol.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤1000), and the second line contains n integers in the range −100000..100000.
en.output: Output the maximum absolute difference between adjacent elements of the original array; for a single-element array, output 0.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: Keep the original order of the array.
